lg.l:
Shot gold, maroon and violet, dazzling silver,
emerald, fawn,

The earth's whole amplitude and Nature's
multiform power consigned for once
to colors

The‸light, the very air diffused inpossess'd by them,—colors till now
unknown

No limits confines—not the west theernsky
alone—the high meridian—north,
south, all,

Pure, ‸varied, brilliant colors, varied, fusedbrilliant and fighting the silent shadows to
the last.
